text: Pinterest, Inc. is a NYSE-listed company. Its 2026 proxy statement names co-founders Benjamin Silbermann and Paul Sciarra (35.33% and 31.19% of total voting power) and US asset managers BlackRock and Vanguard (12.01% and 12.12% of Class A shares) as its largest holders. No state or state-fund shareholder appears.
